messages.subject: Run models error command
messages.body_plain:
Hi!

I am new to this package and am encountering some errors. I want to run a Monte Carlo simulation in Mplus using the R package. I entered: library(MplusAutomation)

runModels("C:\\Users\\Janie\\Documents\\Power Analysis\\PhD PA CWBO 150.inp", recursive = True)

and I receive the below error:
Error in paste("\tRecursive (run models in subdirectories):", as.character(recursive)) :
  object 'True' not found

Does anyone know how to fix this?
